method: Executed four offline unittest checks: bounded historical claims, exact equality between the full Python fence stdout and published output, exhaustive one-digit mutation detection, strict schema/scoring cases, rejection of Unicode digit lookalikes and non-string helper input, and 88-character line width. The 450,000 mutation probe completed locally; no provider request or image input was used.
limitations: The 2026-10-08 contrast, density, and cell-error summaries have no archived per-call requests/responses, precise backend model snapshot, or reproducible scorer; the old provider results were not reproduced.

The old grader parsed a JSON substring and compared expected field strings but did not validate exact row count, extra rows/keys, a complete schema, numeric ranges, finish reason, or usage. The listed 352/360 and error examples cannot be independently confirmed.

Local exhaustive Luhn checks prove properties of this implementation for one-digit changes in four-digit bodies and the listed examples only; they do not establish image-reading performance, detection rates for multi-character errors, or data authenticity.
providerCalls=0; no current model quality, visual behavior, or production extraction reliability is verified.
